security.title: Security isn't a promise here: this page queries the server.
security.subtitle: Bilan handles the money of associations and small organisations. Every sensitive value is encrypted with a per-workspace key, files live in a private EU bucket, and everything shown below is read live from the backend.

live.notice: Values read live from the deployment (nothing hard-coded).

encryption.title: Application-level encryption at rest
encryption.body: IBAN, BIC, SIRET, contact details and notes are encrypted before they hit the database. A single root key stays in the backend environment; each workspace gets its own derived key and every value is bound to its workspace, table and field.

auth.title: One identity, two backends
auth.body: Authentication is delegated to WorkOS AuthKit. The same RS256-signed token is verified by Bilan's backend and by the shared A2E Core database: no token exchange, no stored passwords.

files.title: Files in a private bucket
files.body: No file is public. A2E Core issues short-lived signed URLs, only to a verified workspace member. Storage keys never reach the browser.

residency.title: Hosted in Europe
residency.body: Application database, shared database and file storage all sit in the European Union. Non-EU sub-processors are covered by standard contractual clauses.

fields.title: Exactly what is encrypted
fields.body: We prefer an exact list to a marketing claim. This list is the same source of truth the code uses.

architecture.title: Where your data lives
architecture.body: Bilan is part of the A2E suite: one shared database for what is common, a dedicated one for accounting. That split keeps the blast radius small and the books isolated.

bilan.title: Bilan database
bilan.body: Invoices, transactions, budgets, books, sheets, CERFA, organisation identity (encrypted).

core.title: A2E Core
core.body: Identities, workspaces, members, roles, invitations, notifications, tasks, contacts, audit trail.

drive.title: A2E Drive (B2)
drive.body: Supporting files linked to an expense, invoice or project — private bucket, signed links.

gdpr.title: GDPR, end to end
gdpr.body: Record of processing, lawful basis, retention, sub-processors and rights: all exposed and actionable from inside the app.

practices.title: Engineering practices
practices.item1: Every backend function derives the user from the verified token: a client-supplied id is never trusted.
practices.item2: Workspace access is checked against a membership mirror refreshed by a secret-gated server-to-server bridge.
practices.item3: No secret in the browser bundle: only public deployment URLs and the WorkOS client id ship to the client.
practices.item4: Public share links are re-validated on every request (expiry, revocation, passphrase).
practices.item5: Ciphertexts are context-bound: moving one into another column makes it undecryptable.
practices.item6: The audit trail is append-only at the application level and exportable for your own controls.
practices.item7: Controlled degradation: if the shared layer fails, Bilan keeps running on its own data instead of erroring out.
practices.item8: Quotas are enforced server-side, never only in the UI.

ai.privacyNote: Only the description you type is sent to the Google Gemini model. No amount, no proof, no personal data leaves Bilan.
ai.consentBody: To find relevant schemes, your project description is sent to Google Gemini (sub-processor, transfer covered by standard contractual clauses).
